name: Sphinx of the Second Sun
oracle_text:
Flying
At the beginning of each of your postcombat main phases, there is an additional beginning phase after this phase. (The beginning phase includes the untap, upkeep, and draw steps.)
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of each of your postcombat main phases, there is an additional beginning phase after this phase. (The beginning phase includes the untap, upkeep, and draw steps.)

needs.what: an op that inserts an additional beginning phase (untap, upkeep and draw steps, rule 500.8) immediately after the current phase of the current turn, so the turn proceeds postcombat main -> untap -> upkeep -> draw -> end phase, with untap/upkeep/draw triggers firing again
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The postcombat_main trigger event exists, but no op adds a phase: extra_combat (with extra_main) only inserts combat and main phases, extra_turn adds a whole turn, and untap/draw ops only mimic pieces without creating an untap step, upkeep or draw step that triggers and step-based effects see
